name: toolmetric
description: ToolMetric monorepo: web app, API service, and shared calculation modules.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @toolmetric/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @toolmetric/api" "npm run dev -w @toolmetric/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @toolmetric/shared && npm run build -w @toolmetric/api && npm run build -w @toolmetric/web
scripts.build:local: npm run build -w @toolmetric/shared && npm run build -w @toolmetric/api && npm run build:local -w @toolmetric/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @toolmetric/shared && npm run test -w @toolmetric/shared && npm run test -w @toolmetric/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @toolmetric/shared && npm run typecheck -w @toolmetric/api && npm run typecheck -w @toolmetric/web
scripts.launch-check: npm run build -w @toolmetric/shared && npm run launch-check -w @toolmetric/web
